name: fall_back
text: A standing person suddenly loses balance backward, throws both arms forward trying to recover, knees buckle and the hips drop quickly down. They fall onto their buttocks on the ground with bent knees and feet in front, bracing with hands behind. End seated on the ground, torso upright. One continuous backward fall to sitting, stay down afterward.
repair: Preserve body timing and pose; horizontal finger direction for low hands. Regenerate, never edit final motion arrays.

review.notes_zh: 从站姿失衡后退、屈膝跌坐，双手后撑保持坐地。手掌朝向与趾端角度约束修正明显穿地，最终最低为落地过渡中的左脚趾末端约-2.1厘米，未宣称皮肤层面零穿模。
